'''Rieekan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bureau Chief]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and was in charge of SIS operations on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces took over the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] and kidnapped SIS [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]], Rieekan enlisted the help of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] to secure the project and rescue Agent Galen. However, Imperial forces raided the [[SIS safe house|SIS headquarters]] and killed Rieekan along with several other SIS agents.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]], Rieekan joined the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] (SIS) sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the year [[3643 BBY]], Rieekan had become the [[Bureau Chief]] of the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] SIS branch. His unit kept a [[SIS safe house|headquarters]] hidden on the [[Promenade]], accessed by a secret turbolift behind [[Gudnem's Gadget Emporium]].<ref name="SWTOR:SFAG" />

In [[3643 BBY]], the apprentice of [[Darth Angral]], Lord [[Sadic]], seized control of the Republic's [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] on the planet. Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the SIS had arrived a few days earlier to secure the project, but he disappeared after contacting Rieekan. A [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] would arrive not long after, searching for both the project and Galen.<ref name="SWTOR:SFAG" />

Despite the fact that only half of his agents responded to the omega alert sent out by his subordinate [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] [[Korol Tander]], Rieekan was adamant on not abandoning their base under the shop. He sent the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] to the [[Nikto Sector]] in search of Galen, who had gone missing while looking for a contact that had been kidnapped by Angral's forces. He instructed the Knight to find Galen's reports that the agent had dead-dropped at specific points around the area, but warned him that the Sector was under the control of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] gang the [[Kintan Kings]].<ref name="SWTOR:SFAG" />

After the Knight found Galen's reports, Rieekan decoded them and told the Jedi about their contents. Galen's trail had ended at the [[Power Guard recruitment center]], and the Jedi found the facility under the control of Imperial forces. The Knight defeated the Imperial shocktroopers who had seized the center, and freed [[Vell Narroc]] and the other recruiters. Using Narroc's information, the Jedi and Rieekan discovered that the Power Guard lab was located in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]]. Rieekan instructed the Knight to destroy the sector's power grid so that they could discover the exact location.<ref name="SWTOR:SFAG" />

The Knight followed the trail to the main [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]], where he found Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Graul (Human)|Graul]] communicating with Lord Sadic via holocomm. The Knight defeated Graul and his Mark I Power Guards, and then rushed back to the SIS base&mdash;but it was too late. Sadic's Mark II Power Guards had already attacked the base, killing Rieekan.<ref name="SWTORstrike" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rieekan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the main story quests for the Jedi Knight story arc on Nar Shaddaa.
